name: Shelve
description: a creature can fold itself into a small, almost flat form, perfect for hiding on bookshelves. The creature can still be recognized as something other than a book by someone who handles it (doesn’t just glance at it on the shelf) and makes a successful DC 11 Intelligence (Nature or Investigation) check. The creature can hop or fly (clumsily, by flapping its pages) 5 feet per turn in this form.
